sql: CREATE TABLE materializer_crash_relation(id int primary key, v text); INSERT INTO materializer_crash_relation VALUES (1, 'old-durable-value')
SELECT v FROM materializer_crash_relation WHERE id=1

UPDATE materializer_crash_relation SET v=repeat('new-replayed-value-', 20) WHERE id=1; INSERT INTO materializer_crash_relation SELECT g, repeat('new-replayed-value-', 20) FROM generate_series(2, 300) AS g
